limitations: Synthetic 1D illumination and horizontal PSF, no claim of real cylindrical lighting or camera optics.
Single-image row evidence, not 3D centerline recovery or topology.
Reliable opposite photometric edges do not certify geometric silhouette edges.
Rejecting pair disagreement cannot detect a unique internal highlight or painted background stripe.
Flat-background-like absence can also be a low-contrast physical rod; absence is not certified.

frozen_protocol.scope: Pre-registered analytic profile mechanism controls, not new real-data or held-out performance tuning.

generator.blur: normalized discrete Gaussian along x after horizontal pixel-area integration, radius ceil(4*sigma)
generator.quantization: clip to 0..255 then numpy rint uint8; identical RGB channels

evaluation.ambiguity: No unique GT identity; an accepted line is an unsupported identity choice, not assigned to the nearest GT object.
evaluation.absence: Count absent hypotheses on physical rod rows as false absences, including invisible/weak-boundary cases.

hypotheses: Opposite photometric edges need not be silhouette edges; report center and boundary error separately.
Rejecting disagreeing reliable pair centers may reduce unsafe acceptance but costs coverage.
A unique narrow highlight may remain confidently wrong under both methods; the conservative control is not required to win.
Static texture can imitate a rod or fill a true gap; no single-view intensity proof of 3D identity is claimed.

boundary_assertions.generator_truth: Known geometric interval before intensity profile, blur, pixel-area integration, and quantization.
boundary_assertions.method_inputs: RGB, a common coarse guide [[64,12],[64,148]], frozen method settings only.
boundary_assertions.inference_files: Inference reads data/inputs and .runtime method settings, never eval_gt or fixture definitions.
boundary_assertions.selection: Candidate index comes from the method fitter; evaluator never chooses the closest-to-GT pair.
boundary_assertions.ambiguity: Two equal physical objects have no unique target identity; nearest-object GT assignment is forbidden.
boundary_assertions.ordering: All case predictions were frozen before the separate evaluate command.
boundary_assertions.absence: Flat-background-like absence is a hypothesis; score false hypotheses on weak physical rods.
boundary_assertions.failures: All 44 method/case records are retained, including rejections, ambiguous fits, and null metrics.
boundary_assertions.figure: Six pre-requested case IDs p01,p07,p09,p12,p14,p19, all at row80; a diagnostic selection, not a ranking.
